peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 17.1% above its local comparables; 52 of 54 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (76.4): 3.8 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 68 of 91 similar developments with a figure (the same as 3). Context, not scored: resales in 58.3% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $1,374,000 ($1,348 psf, 1,011–1,087 sq ft; 10 resales, Sep 2024–Aug 2026); 5 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,161 psf (range $1,027–1,265); 16.1% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $191,000 more. 3-bedroom: median $1,950,000 ($1,438 psf, 1,334–1,474 sq ft; 10 resales, Jul 2024–Jun 2026); 7 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,218 psf (range $1,080–1,265); 18.1% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $298,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Bukit Batok MRT about 70 m, Bukit Gombak MRT about 1,140 m; closer than 91 of 94 similar developments (the same as 2). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 4 within 1 km and 10 within 2 km; nearest Bukit View Primary School about 630 m; more than 73 of 94 similar developments (the same as 16). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 7 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 70 m), more than 90 of 94 similar developments (the same as 2); nearest hawker centre Bukit Batok West Hawker Centre about 1,040 m; nearest park Bukit Batok Town Park about 830 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 1 other condo development sold new homes within 2 km (J'Den, 9 new sales, about 1,990 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 35 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 122 new sales and 262 resales (384 purchases); new sales were 31.8% of these purchases. Subsales (0) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 262 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 17 of 94 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 262 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 301 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−13%). Planning-area private resales −2.8%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
